title: Lightloom plugin source
description: One entry of the plugin sources manager: a git repository or a local directory that contributes plugins, components or effects. Sources are hash-pinned (pinned_sha256 of the checked-out tree listing) and updated only on explicit user action. A source is not loaded until the user has read and acknowledged its license text (license_text_acknowledged_at). WhirlwindFX-authored files are never a source; the import wizard handles the user's own copies separately.

id.description: Stable slug for the source (defaults to a hash of url).

kind.description: git: cloned with a git client into the sources cache; path: an existing local directory used in place (never modified).

url.description: git: https:// or ssh clone URL; path: absolute local directory path or file:// URL.

ref.description: git only: branch, tag or commit to fetch.

pinned_sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the canonical tree listing (sorted relative path + blob SHA-256 per file) at the last approved update. Content differing from the pin is not loaded until the user approves the diff.

pinned_commit.description: git only: commit SHA-1 the pin was taken from.

license.description: SPDX expression of the source's license as declared by the repo (informational).

license_text_sha256.description: Hash of the license text that was shown; a changed license text re-triggers acknowledgement.

license_text_acknowledged_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the user's acknowledgement of the license text; null/absent = not yet acknowledged, source stays disabled.

enabled.description: Whether plugins from this source are loaded. Effective only when license_text_acknowledged_at is set.

subdirs.description: Optional sub-directories inside the source to scan (defaults: Plugins, Components, Effects at the root).

preset.description: true for sources pre-listed by Lightloom (user can still remove them).
